item.text: The files contain 497 bank patches and 997 test patches. The weaker model almost never predicts several classes, including wetlands and transitional woodland, while the stronger bank model identifies many more. Some captions also report water where the measured water share is near zero. I’ll treat both sources as noisy evidence and test how well features, band statistics, and text predict held-out stronger-model answers.

I’ve generated the 997 × 15 probability array and am checking its values and ordering. These checks measure consistency with the stronger model; they cannot establish accuracy against true land cover.
